privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At CoreLogic Systems, we are committed to protecting the privacy of our clients and website visitors. This policy provides a general overview of how we handle personal information. Visitors in Germany and the EU can also consult our dedicated Datenschutz notice.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you voluntarily provide when you contact us, submit an inquiry form, use our AI chat assistant, or request a consultation — such as your name, email address, WhatsApp/phone number, and project summary.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use this information solely to respond to your inquiry, schedule consultations, prepare project proposals, and provide requested technical support. We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Security & Third-Party Infrastructure
sections.body: We use modern encrypted transport (HTTPS) and access controls to safeguard stored data. Details on all infrastructure and service providers used by this website are documented on our Datenschutz page.

sections.heading: 4. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy as our services evolve. Any updates will be published on this page.

sections.heading: 5. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions regarding privacy or wish to request deletion of your contact inquiry, please reach out via our Contact page or email contact@corelogic-system.my.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to CoreLogic Systems. By using this website and engaging our software development services, the following general terms apply:

sections.heading: 1. Scope
sections.body: These terms govern general use of the CoreLogic Systems website. Individual software development, design, or AI automation engagements are governed by separate written project agreements defining scope, milestones, pricing, and deliverables.

sections.heading: 2. Services Provided
sections.body: We provide custom software development, web and mobile application engineering, UI/UX design, and AI workflow automation. Any indicative estimates discussed prior to technical review are non-binding.

sections.heading: 3. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content displayed on this website, including text, designs, and brand assets, is owned by CoreLogic Systems and may not be copied without permission. Intellectual property rights for custom client deliverables are defined in the respective client contract.

sections.heading: 4. Disclaimer of Liability
sections.body: We take care to keep website information accurate and available, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability or absence of occasional technical errors. Statutory liability rules remain unaffected.

sections.heading: 5. Modifications
sections.body: We reserve the right to update these Terms of Service when necessary. The current version published on this page applies.
